data.name: Pontoon 16 - Mission Bay Rental
data.headline: 2-4 hour options
data.description:
Our Pontoon 16′ is great for picnics and family outings on Mission Bay.

The Starcraft LX 16 is a family-friendly pontoon boat with a maximum power rating of 40 HP.

Its standard features, such as its Bimini top and ample seating, provide all-day comfort, and with a capacity of six persons, you won't have to worry about leaving anyone behind.
data.what_is_included:
Max of 6 passengers including children
Must be 18+ to rent and drive
40hp Mercury outboard engine
Pets allowed
Life vests included (all sizes)

data.cancellation_notes: Any changes or cancellations must be made at least 3 days (72 hours) prior to your reservation start date for a full refund. Once you are within 72 hours, no changes or cancellations are permitted. Failure to show for reservation still incurs full rental rate and is not eligible for a refund or reschedule. As the renter, you are responsible for checking the weather forecast and making any desired changes at least 72 hours in advance.
